calendar_nights_definition: checkout local date minus checkin local date; not elapsed flight days

tables.flight_rules: rule_id; operating_carrier; marketing_carrier; flight_no; origin_airport_id; destination_airport_id; departure_local_time; arrival_local_time; arrival_day_offset; origin_iana; destination_iana; valid_from; valid_to; weekdays_iso; exceptions; intermediate_stops; source_snapshot; source_locator; scope_status
tables.dated_flights: instance_id; rule_id; departure_local_date; departure_local_datetime; arrival_local_datetime; departure_utc; arrival_utc; instance_status=PLANNED_FROM_RULE or PUBLISHED_DATED_SCHEDULE, never PERFORMED without operation fact
tables.stay_rules: stay_rule_id; property_id; checkin_local_time; checkout_local_time; iana; minimum_nights; early_late_terms; valid_from; valid_to; source_snapshot
tables.transfer_rules: transfer_id; origin_place; destination_place; duration_minutes; duration_status; validity; local_departure_arrival; iana; price_reference_only; source_snapshot
tables.fare_quotes: quote_id; observed_at_utc; source; travel_dates; passenger_scope; baggage; refund_change_conditions; gross_total; currency; price_scope; availability_status; never realised_revenue
tables.stay_products: product_id; outbound_instance_id; return_instance_id; checkin_date; checkout_date; target_nights; actual_nights; stay_rule_id; transfer_ids; compatibility_status; unresolved_conditions; price_quote_ids

prohibitions: No source absence to zero demand
No fare to realised airline revenue
No quarantined Telegram as auxiliary join
handoff: Peer consumes only SHA-pinned completed input manifest, not a live folder or this schema draft
